select deadline1.* from ( SELECT A.BUSI_DATE busiDate, A.MARKET_CODE marketCode, A.IS_HOLIDAY isHoliday, A.STATUS status, A.DEPT_CODE deptCode, row_number() over (partition by A.MARKET_CODE
order by A.BUSI_DATE desc
order by A.BUSI_DATE asc
) as num FROM CHB_MKT_HOLIDAY A
A.BUSI_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{holidayDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
A.BUSI_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{holidayDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.MARKET_CODE = #{marketCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.STATUS = 'E' AND A.IS_HOLIDAY = '1'
) deadline1 where deadline1.num = 1

SELECT DISTINCT T.LARGE_SH_DATE FROM REP_PROD_INFO_TA T WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM REP_PROD_INFO_TA T1 WHERE T.PROD_ID=T1.PROD_ID AND T1.AFTER_RAISE_MAX!=T.AFTER_RAISE_MAX AND T1.CHANGE_DATE = (SELECT MAX(CHANGE_DATE) FROM REP_PROD_INFO_TA WHERE CHANGE_DATE < T.CHANGE_DATE)) AND IS_LARGE_SH='0' AND LARGE_SH_DATE = #{NOW(), jdbcType=DATE} AND PROD_ID= #{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT count(1) FROM rep_fee_yield WHERE BUSI_ID = #{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND STATUS = 'E' AND START_DATE = #{NOW(), jdbcType=DATE} AND BUSI_ID IN ( SELECT BUSI_ID FROM rep_fee_yield where START_DATE < #{NOW(), jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY BUSI_ID HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 )

order by A.BUSI_DATE desc
